models.deep.memory.dnc module¶

Differentiable Neural Computer (DNC) - Neural network with external memory

class models.deep.memory.dnc.DNC(input_dim: int, hidden_dim: int = 128, memory_size: int = 64, memory_dim: int = 32, num_reads: int = 4, output_dim: int = 10, controller_type: Literal['lstm', 'linear'] = 'lstm', output_type: Literal['prediction', 'embedding'] = 'prediction')[source]¶

Bases: Module

Differentiable Neural Computer (DNC).

A neural network architecture with an external memory matrix that can be read from and written to in a differentiable manner.

Parameters:

  • input_dim – Input feature dimension

  • hidden_dim – Hidden dimension of controller network

  • memory_size – Number of memory slots

  • memory_dim – Dimension of each memory slot

  • num_reads – Number of read heads

  • output_dim – Output dimension

  • controller_type – Type of controller (‘lstm’ or ‘linear’)

  • output_type – ‘prediction’ returns output, ‘embedding’ returns controller state

  • return_sequence – If True, return output for each timestep

Returns:

Output tensor of shape (batch_size, output_dim) or (batch_size, seq_len, output_dim)

External memory module for DNC.

Implements content-based addressing, temporal memory linkage, and allocation/deallocation mechanisms.

  • memory_dim – Dimension of each memory slot (W)

Content-based addressing using cosine similarity.

  • key – Key vector (batch, W)

  • strength – Strength scalar (batch, 1)

Returns:

Content weights (batch, N)

Read from memory using read weights.

Parameters:

Returns:

Read vectors (batch, num_reads, W)

update_memory(memory: Tensor, write_weights: Tensor, erase_vector: Tensor, write_vector: Tensor) → Tensor[source]¶

Update memory using write weights, erase vector, and write vector.

Memory update: M_t = M_{t-1} * (1 - w_t^w * e_t^T) + w_t^w * a_t^T

Parameters:

  • memory – Current memory (batch, N, W)

  • write_weights – Write weights (batch, N)

  • erase_vector – Erase vector (batch, W)

  • write_vector – Write vector (batch, W)

Returns:

Updated memory (batch, N, W)

class models.deep.memory.ntm.NTMMemory(memory_size: int, memory_dim: int)[source]¶

Bases: Module

External memory module for Neural Turing Machine.

Implements content-based and location-based addressing mechanisms.

Parameters:

  • memory_size – Number of memory slots (N)

  • memory_dim – Dimension of each memory slot (M)

content_addressing(memory: Tensor, key: Tensor, strength: Tensor) → Tensor[source]¶

Content-based addressing using cosine similarity.

w_c = softmax(β * K(k, M))

Parameters:

  • memory – Memory matrix (batch, N, M)

  • key – Key vector (batch, M)

  • strength – Key strength β (batch, 1)

Returns:

Content weights (batch, N)

location_addressing(content_weights: Tensor, gate: Tensor, shift: Tensor, sharpen: Tensor, prev_weights: Tensor) → Tensor[source]¶

Location-based addressing with interpolation, shift, and sharpening.

  1. Interpolation: w_g = g*w_c + (1-g)*w_{t-1}

  2. Shift: w_s = circular_conv(w_g, s)

  3. Sharpen: w_t = w_s^γ / sum(w_s^γ)

Parameters:

  • content_weights – Content-based weights (batch, N)

  • gate – Interpolation gate g ∈ [0,1] (batch, 1)

  • shift – Shift distribution (batch, shift_range)

  • sharpen – Sharpening factor γ >= 1 (batch, 1)

  • prev_weights – Previous weights (batch, N)

Returns:

Final addressing weights (batch, N)

Module contents¶

Memory-Augmented Neural Networks (MANNs).

Architectures with external memory access: - Neural Turing Machines (NTM) - Differentiable Neural Computers (DNC)
